legend.registry.recyclingExtra: Covers only the materials the source lists; if none are tagged, recyclable materials are not inferred.
legend.registry.disasterSheltersSource: National Fire Agency, Ministry of the Interior · data.gov.tw 73242
legend.registry.disasterSheltersExtra: These are designated shelters; it does not mean they are open now.
legend.registry.nationalParksSource: National Park Service / Marine National Park Headquarters / TGOS
legend.registry.nationalParksExtra: Plan editions differ by park; this does not show real-time open or restricted status.
legend.registry.newTaipeiBridgesRow1: Approximate axis; not the registered length
legend.registry.newTaipeiBridgesRow2: Dot: source endpoints coincide, so no axis can be derived
legend.registry.tainanInspectionsRow: Location of official inspection records; not real-time safety status
legend.registry.hsinchuBridgesRow: Approximate line between bridge ends; not the bridge body
legend.registry.taipeiTunnelsRow: Official registry point; not the tunnel corridor
legend.registry.changhuaSignalsRow: Signal register point; not live signal state
legend.registry.bridgeRainRow1: Listed rainfall condition reached; not a bridge-closure decision
legend.registry.bridgeRainRow2: Below the verified rainfall threshold; not a safety determination
legend.registry.bridgeRainRow3: Missing, outdated, or threshold pending review
legend.registry.factoryDensityNote: Operating-factory registrations as of 202606; only factories with coordinates.
legend.registry.manufacturingDensityNote: Registered addresses of manufacturing companies as of 202608; not the addresses where factories actually operate.
legend.registry.regulatedDensityNote: Active regulated facilities as of 20260818; regulated status is not pollution risk.
legend.registry.gbCoDistrictNote: Each dot is one postcode district ({n} districts, {total} companies), aggregated by registered-office postcode district — not trading locations
legend.registry.gbMfgNote: Manufacturing = first registered SIC code in section C ({total} companies); districts with none are not drawn
legend.registry.gbCoAgentNote: Districts hosting company-formation agent addresses appear inflated
legend.registry.gbCoNiNote: Northern Ireland: not covered (postcode licence restriction)
legend.registry.gbCoLicenceNote: Companies House register snapshot {date}; no re-use restrictions on the public register, source must be acknowledged (not OGL)
